question: Rupesh got an increase of 4% in his sales amount in the first year and 25% in the second year; also with this, his current sales are ₹1,35,200, what was his sales (in ₹) two years ago?
solution:
**Given:**

First year increase = 4%

Second year increase = 25%

Current sales = 135200

**Formula Used:**

Final Value = Initial Value × (1 + r₁) × (1 + r₂)

Initial Value = Final Value &
